First-year applicants self-report grades through STARS; waitlisted students should update STARS with mid-year grades (final decisions by Aug 1). App fee $70. Honors consideration needs a short statement whose prompt Rutgers does not publish online (gap)
No supplemental essays on the Common App; one personal essay required (Common App 250-650 words, or Rutgers Application 3,800 characters, on one of Rutgers' listed topics)
